lines.zh: 我一步一步压过来，很沉
lines.en: I press forward one heavy step at a time.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀把枝条全都撞断
lines.en: My shoulders snap every branch aside.
Deep prints stay in the ground.
I'm not fast, but I never change course.

lines.zh: 我的躯干像一堵会走的墙
lines.en: My torso is a wall that walks.

lines.zh: 每走一步，尘土就跳一下
lines.en: Dust jumps with every step.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂着，指节很粗
lines.en: My arms hang low with thick knuckles.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草全平了
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I pass.
I change my mind and take half a step back.
I shove the tree trunk out of my way.

lines.zh: 我的影子把路整个盖住
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole path.
I don't go around. I push through.
I stand, breathing coarsely.
Held this long, my fingers have gone stiff.

lines.zh: 我在等另一副脚步靠近
lines.en: I wait for another set of steps.

lines.zh: 空旷的地方让我不耐烦
lines.en: Open ground makes me restless.
I turn my neck slowly.
My chest rises and falls.
The calluses on my knuckles have split.
I pack the soil down under my feet.
There's some movement far off.

lines.zh: 我不着急，我有的是力气
lines.en: No hurry. I have strength to spare.

lines.zh: 我把一只拳头举起来看看
lines.en: I raise one fist to look at it.
The wind breaks against me.
I shift my weight forward.

lines.zh: 我在听那个声音会不会再来
lines.en: I listen to see if the sound returns.
I wait for you to catch your breath.
You're much smaller than I am.
My head tilts slightly.
You're standing still. That's rare.
My fingers loosen one by one.
I'm guessing how heavy you are.
All muscle, built for ramming.

lines.zh: 我往前走了一步，就一步
lines.en: I take one step. Just one.
Your feet haven't moved back.
Good. That saves me the chase.
I raise my shoulders again.
My shadow reaches your feet.
You don't shout, and you don't run.
Then I needn't rush either.

lines.zh: 我们就这样看了一会儿
lines.en: So we look at each other a while.
I've looked enough. So be it.
I've already raised my hand.
You'd better move now.
Staying put is your choice too.
Then I'll take that as a yes.
I sway once. Just once.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我肩上，闷响
lines.en: That lands on my shoulder with a thud.
My hide is thick. The blood comes slowly.

lines.zh: 血从厚皮里慢慢渗出来。
lines.en: Blood seeps slowly through my thick hide.
Then I raise my head.
The hide on my shoulder twitches.
That doesn't happen often.
I settle my weight a little lower.
Now I'll be serious.
Don't count on doing that twice.
You hold up that little thing.
It's not even one finger's worth.
I don't eat any of this.
Set it down and your hands are empty.
Empty hands are easier to catch.
One glance. No interest.
That won't stop my path.
Step back and I'll pretend not to see.
Don't wave it in front of me.
It's starting to annoy me.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我几乎没有动
lines.en: You hit me and I barely shift.

lines.zh: 这一下连我的肩膀都没推开
lines.en: That didn't even turn my shoulder.
You bounce off and hit the ground.
My foot sinks the soil.
I watch you get up.
That bump didn't anger me.
It only told me where you are.
You are squeezed flat against the wall.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我胸口，没动。
lines.en: You drive your shoulder into my chest. Nothing moves.
Don't stand by my feet.
Another and I always come as a pair.

lines.zh: 那一个比我瘦，也比我快
lines.en: That one is thinner, and quicker.
We close from both ends.

lines.zh: 你只要跑，我们就会合上
lines.en: Run, and we close in.
We understand each other without words.
I hold the front; it circles behind.
This body takes no mate.
But teamwork is another matter.
We never get separated.
Do you hear two sets of steps?
I bend and the ground creaks.

lines.zh: 我用拇指和食指捏起来
lines.en: I pinch it up thumb and forefinger.
Too small. It slips easily.
I squeeze and it deforms.
You dropped it; I pick it up to look.
Can't make sense of it. Toss it back.
My hand isn't made for holding things.
I don't keep useless things.
Useful things I crush in my grip.
Which finishes them off, mostly.
I lower my shoulder and walk straight at you.
I don't go around anyone.
My shoulder has dropped.
This charge will put you down.

lines.zh: 你跑不了多远，我很确定
lines.en: You won't get far. I'm sure of it.
My fist is bigger than your head.
I count three and lunge.
You could also run now.
Running makes it more interesting.
Then I'll assume you're staying.
The ground under me is solid.
The ground under you is trembling.
This hand is already up.
I lift my foot and wait for you to choose.
Now the chance is gone.
Come here. Stop backing off.
I dog your heels without a gap.
You're flat against the trunk.

lines.zh: 那棵树挡不住我的力气
lines.en: That tree won't take my strength.
You slip out from behind it.
I turn around, slowly.
Turning is slow, but I don't stop.
Your steps grow more ragged.
I track where you gasp for breath.
That sound keeps getting closer.
It's my footsteps.
You've backed into the open.
Nothing to hide behind in the open.
I raise both hands.
This won't be just one blow.

lines.zh: 你听见那闷闷的声响吗
lines.en: Hear that dull thudding?
That's my footsteps.
I'm right at the back of your neck.
The hour to strike has come.
Don't turn around to look.
It's already too late.
Gravel sprays into your face.
This charge flattens you.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌按在你的后背
lines.en: I plant a palm flat on your back.
You slide a good distance.
I plant a foot on your shadow.
I held back three-tenths of that.
Your armour has caved in.
The other fist comes up as well.
You can still stand. Good.

lines.zh: 第二拳落在你的护肩上。
lines.en: The second punch lands on your pauldron.
I don't need to wind up.
The hand goes up and down.

lines.zh: 我这副身板是靠力气撑的。
lines.en: This body of mine runs on brute strength.

lines.zh: 那些石头我会一起推倒
lines.en: I'll push those stones down with you.
This one closes it out.
That blow finishes it.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，地面动了一下
lines.en: When I appear, the ground jolts.

lines.zh: 我站在你身后，你没转身。
lines.en: I stand behind you and you do not turn.
Every part of this body is taut.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，没有能挡住我的
lines.en: I look around. Nothing can stop me.
I roll my shoulders up.
Every bird far off has taken flight.
My partner isn't on this side.
It'll show up on the other side.

lines.zh: 我先站一会儿，等你注意到
lines.en: I'll stand a moment, till you notice.
The dust announces me first.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，让你看见
lines.en: I shift half a step so you can see.
Now you see me.
Then it starts with this step.

lines.zh: 我一落地，整片林子都静了。
lines.en: I land and the whole forest goes silent.
I've no need to run at all.
I only have to keep walking.
Everyone stops eventually.
I'll be there for that moment.
This place is very empty.
That suits me exactly.

lines.zh: 火烧在我的皮上，我只皱眉
lines.en: Fire on my hide. I only frown.

lines.zh: 我掉下来，把地面砸出一个坑
lines.en: I land and punch a crater in the ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我很不喜欢
lines.en: Water pours into my mouth. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推着滑了半步
lines.en: The blast slides me back half a step.
I reach up and pull it out.

lines.zh: 这股力量绕过了我的皮
lines.en: That force went around my hide.
Hunger has drained my hands.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我僵了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I lock up an instant.

lines.zh: 我的重量在虚空里没有落点。
lines.en: My weight finds nothing to land on in the void.
